gps_model: NEO-6 declared; identification via MON-VER fields
time_source: TIM2 16-bit + overflow extension, nominal 1 MHz HSI PLL
imu_timestamp: later ACC/GYRO DRDY IRQ; no bus/read/write timestamp reconstruction
gps_row_time: last required UBX byte or assembly deadline; NOT GNSS measurement time
utc: UTC, UART arrival interpolated, auxiliary only; no PPS or holdover guarantee
axis_frame: sensor PCB XYZ; no vehicle rotation, gravity removal or startup zeroing
invalid_imu: six empty vector fields; IMU_FLAGS: SPI=1,FRESH=2,PAIR=4,CLIP=8,TIMEOUT=16
gps_states: N=new valid epoch once, R=immutable repetition, I=no valid position
filters: unchanged sensor defaults plus CTRL1/2/3/4 above; group delay NOT bench validated
